M3 optional filtered and sorted collection pack
Copyright 2026 Hitesh Soliwal and contributors

The generic facades and primitive row projection were adapted from the Apache-2.0
source owners in hsoliwal/com.synexia. Original per-file copyright and SPDX
notices remain in every projected file. Modification notices identify the
M3JDK package and class-name projection. See PROJECTION_SOURCE_IDENTITY.json.

The complete existing com.m3.collections module and its JNI peer are compiled
from their original M3JDK source paths, with the accompanying original notice.
This module pack does not change OpenJDK licensing or replace java.util APIs.
No Guava, Commons Collections, LeetCode, HackerRank or GeeksforGeeks source
implementation was copied into these first-party classes.
